svg.title: Gridpico RP2040-Zero carrier — one-page draft review
svg.desc: Functional power and signal lines collapse pin groups and passive parts. Tables cover every carrier reference in the archived netlist.
svg.text: Functional connections and complete parts index. Passive parts and common ground are omitted from the drawing.
Independent input protection feeds separate selectors
for module, USB Host and SD/OLED power. U3 already uses U1.
First cut: consolidate USB data ESD
Replace four discrete USB data clamps with two compatible
dual-channel parts. Check leakage, capacitance and clamp.
U4: each host node needs local power; the one-supply
Its VBUS-to-VSYS tie needs an isolation redesign or a
U2-only module power mode. The latter loses U1 standalone
operation and still needs USB suspend checks.
Dots mark junctions. M1 controls the Q-group grants through GPIO.
Native USB, downstream USB and input sensing
Purple: bundled signals • dashed blue: power-good controls • repeated IDs are the same physical part
J5/J6 on 3V3_PER. J7/J8 carry data and ground.
180 carrier references • grouped by exact draft part and function • generic parts show the specified value or connector type
Pico MCU, boot flash and onboard
U3 output powered only from U1
U4 VBUS supervisor for host data
ESD clamps: USB lines, UART and
ESD clamps on USB-C CC pins
Passive parts omitted from the drawing
SOURCE: hw/rp2040-zero/draft at 7d5fb9b • Hardware Design review copy • Part substitutions and Rev A remain open
